Turn early data insights into better decisions with Red Flag Alert.
...
Growing a business today means tighter rules, more complex supply chains, and higher expectations. Many teams still rely on manual checks and outdated reports, which slows work and leaves gaps. 

We believe risk decisions should be simple, not stressful. We give you clear, timely information so you can say “yes” to the right customers and no to the wrong ones.
...
Red Flag Alert, a VC backed business, was built by data specialists who'd seen the same problem play out too many times: businesses trying to make confident decisions with out-of-date credit reports. Fast-moving risk doesn't wait around, and neither should your data.

In 2004, we developed our proprietary Health Score, measuring business health using real-time risk signals. Since then, we've expanded to full UK company coverage, built API and bank integrations, developed advanced scoring models, and launched a second office in Cardiff.
...
Our mission has never changed. Today, with AI-driven insight and automation, businesses that work with us stay ahead of risk rather than just reacting to it.
